description: Defines a Note entity class for persistence with JPA/Hibernate, representing a note record with fields for id, title, content, creation, and update timestamps, including lifecycle callbacks for timestamp management.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Entity class representing a note in a note-taking application, mapped to 'notes' table, with fields for id, title, content, createdAt, updatedAt, and lifecycle methods for timestamp management.

methods.name: prePersist
methods.description: Lifecycle callback to initialize createdAt and updatedAt timestamps before persisting.

methods.name: preUpdate
methods.description: Lifecycle callback to update the updatedAt timestamp before updating the entity.
